♈ The Aries Cloth. DEFENSE

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crystal Wall]

Cloth Passive — Cloth Mending

You are trained in Crafting. You can Repair any Cloth, armor, or shield in 10 minutes with no check, restoring Hit Points equal to ten times your level. A Cloth you repair is fully restored regardless of how it was broken.

Ascendant Boon — Starlight Extinction [DEFENSE]

You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and to all saving throws.

Starlight Extinction ↩ (reaction; frequency once per round; trigger a creature within 60 feet makes a ranged or spell attack, or targets an ally with a spell) — you send the effect nowhere. It is expended with no result.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Aries)]

Zenith Boon — Starlight Extinction (Zenith) [DEFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, and the Starlight Extinction reaction has no frequency limit.

Additionally, once per minute you may target a creature with the reaction instead of an effect: 60 feet, Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC. On a critical failure it is teleported one mile away. This is an incapacitation effect.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Aries)]

11th-Level Cloth Ability — Stardust Revolution

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Stardust Revolution]
